chains.capability: Condense help text using the repository's default short-help semantics with maximum length 20. Input values are strings.
Convert values to display strings using the repository's make-string semantics: bytes use the filesystem encoding with UTF-8 replacement fallback; other values use str.
Escape string or bytes values using the repository's ASCII-escaped diagnostic semantics, including control characters, non-ASCII Unicode and invalid bytes.
Render a callable value as a boolean using the repository's asynchronous-function detection semantics, covering coroutine functions and async generators, not ordinary functions or arbitrary values.
